svg.title: Beef cattle farmer — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as beef cattle farmer, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A broad cattle face has outward horns, side ears and a clear lower muzzle above a feeding barrier. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
